title: AI can act exactly like a human, but we still don't think it's conscious
caption:
Does acting human make a machine conscious? A new study suggests we draw a hard line between machines and humans, even when their behavior is identical. It turns out the words we choose, like 'awareness' versus 'consciousness', reveal a lot about how we really view AI.

Source: Sciencedaily - AI can act exactly like a human, but we still don't think it's conscious
